title: The specified scalar realization preserves ordinary and signed-total tensors
statement: For a finite commutative ring R and scheme T, the specified associated-module realization [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] has the ordinary tensor isomorphism constructed from the fixed-scalar sheafification tensorator and the module-sheafification tensor comparison normalized on pure tensors. Applying the signed total construction gives a natural tensor isomorphism of cochain functors. Define also the class of fixed-scalar complexes that are categorically K-flat and flat in every degree.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary tensor isomorphism of the specified scalar realization by composing the fixed-scalar sheafification tensorator, the sheafification counit, and the module-sheafification tensor comparison normalized on pure tensors. Form its signed total by mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans.

def finiteScalarOrdinaryTensorIso
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] :
    tensor _ ⋙ (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T R).functor ≅
      ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T R).functor.prod
        (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T R).functor) ⋙
          @tensor (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T R)) _
            (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (proEtaleConstantRing T R))
